legal_basis: Reserve Bank of India (Key Facts Statement (KFS)) Directions, 2024; RBI Fair Lending Practice — Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023); RBI Circular on prepayment of floating-rate loans to individual borrowers (2019); read with Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 for penal amounts. Applies to loans from scheduled commercial banks, NBFCs and other RBI-regulated entities; it does not govern private money-lending contracts.

rules.title: RBI Key Facts Statement (KFS) Disclosure

benchmark.typical_label: KFS must be provided before loan signing

rules.detection_hint: If this is a loan from a regulated lender and no Key Facts Statement is attached or referenced, flag it. The KFS must be a separate, one-page statement issued before signing, quoting the sanctioned amount, APR, all fees, penal charges and repayment schedule.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Ask for the RBI Key Facts Statement
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could you share the RBI Key Facts Statement for this loan so I can see the all-in cost and fees before signing?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: Under RBI's KFS Directions, 2024, a Key Facts Statement must be provided before signing. Please share it before I proceed.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: The Lender shall provide the Borrower with the RBI-mandated Key Facts Statement (KFS) disclosing the all-inclusive annualised rate, processing fees, penal charges and total cost of credit prior to execution.

rules.title: All-in cost and APR not disclosed

benchmark.typical_label: APR disclosed on an all-inclusive basis

rules.detection_hint: Flag loan documents that quote only a flat or nominal interest rate and never state the APR (all-inclusive annualised percentage rate) including processing fees, insurance, documentation charges and other deductions. Flat-rate quotes can hide a much higher effective cost.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Get the all-in APR in writing
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could you tell me the all-in APR, including processing fee and insurance, rather than just the flat rate?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: The document quotes only a flat rate with no all-inclusive APR. RBI's KFS Directions require the APR to be disclosed. Please state the effective annualised rate including all fees before I sign.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: The Lender shall disclose the Annualised Percentage Rate (APR) on an all-inclusive basis, including interest, processing fees, insurance and any other charges deducted at disbursement, in the Key Facts Statement.

rules.title: Prepayment penalty on a floating-rate loan

benchmark.typical_label: No prepayment penalty on floating-rate loans to individuals

statutory_citation.act: RBI Circular — Prepayment of floating-rate loans to individual borrowers

rules.detection_hint: Flag any foreclosure or prepayment charge on a floating-rate loan taken by an individual borrower. RBI prohibits lenders from charging prepayment penalties on floating-rate loans to individuals. For fixed-rate loans the charge must still be disclosed up front in the KFS.

negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Since this is a floating-rate loan, could the prepayment penalty be removed? RBI does not allow one for individuals on floating rates.
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: RBI's 2019 circular bars prepayment penalties on floating-rate loans to individual borrowers. Please remove the foreclosure charge in this clause or switch it to a fixed-rate loan with the charge disclosed in the KFS.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: No prepayment or foreclosure charge shall apply where the Borrower prepays a floating-rate loan. For a fixed-rate loan, any prepayment charge shall be disclosed in the Key Facts Statement.

rules.title: Penal interest is compounded or disproportionate

benchmark.typical_label: Flat penal charge, not compounded; no capitalisation

statutory_citation.act: RBI Fair Lending Practice — Penal Charges in Loan Accounts, 2023
statutory_citation.section: Penal charges not to be capitalised or levied as penal interest

rules.detection_hint: Flag clauses that levy penal interest at a compounding rate, add penal charges to the principal, or impose a penal percentage far above the actual loss caused by default. RBI requires penal charges to be a flat, reasonable amount that is not capitalised.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Cap penal charges at a flat amount
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could the penal charge be a flat amount rather than compounding interest added to the principal?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: RBI's 2023 directions require penal charges to be a reasonable flat amount and not capitalised. Please revise this clause so penal charges are not compounded or added to principal.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: Penal charges for delayed payment shall be a flat amount proportionate to the actual loss caused by the default, shall not be capitalised, and shall not exceed the rate disclosed in the Key Facts Statement.

expected_clauses.label: Key Facts Statement attached or referenced
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: Without the KFS the borrower cannot compare the true cost of credit before signing.

expected_clauses.label: Prepayment and foreclosure terms
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: Undisclosed foreclosure charges can make an early payoff unexpectedly expensive.

expected_clauses.label: Grievance redressal and nodal officer
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: RBI-regulated lenders must name a grievance officer; without it, complaints have no escalation path.
